name: snr_uniform_high
description: Temporal RAW noise measurement of a stationary five-object textured scene

geometry.depth_reference: Not applicable to stationary uniform-surface SNR measurement. Camera fixed at x=100 mm; paper distance not measured because depth is not being evaluated.

focus: Fixed lens focus and camera orientation
roi_definition: Central 400x400 RAW pixels: x=760:1160, y=340:740. Same ROI as uniform low and middle.
notes: Exactly the same uniform matte surface, camera position and overhead lighting as the low- and middle-exposure captures. Only exposure changed to 32000 µs. Gain remains 4× with AE disabled. Twenty-four consecutive stationary RAW frames for high-exposure signal, temporal noise and clipping evaluation.
protocol_notes: Temporal RAW SNR needs fixed camera/lighting and a documented ROI; use separate uniform/dark sessions if needed.
